# OpenDroid

> OpenDroid is an open-source autonomous Android agent. This website documents its capabilities, releases, security posture, privacy policy, terms, contributors, and support resources.

## Primary pages
- [Home](https://yashab-cyber.github.io/opendroid/): Product overview and core capabilities.
- [Features](https://yashab-cyber.github.io/opendroid/features.html): Detailed feature and architecture overview.
- [Releases](https://yashab-cyber.github.io/opendroid/releases.html): Published release history and changelog.
- [About](https://yashab-cyber.github.io/opendroid/about.html): Project mission and principles.
- [Contributors](https://yashab-cyber.github.io/opendroid/contributor.html): Contributors and testers.
- [Support](https://yashab-cyber.github.io/opendroid/support.html): Support and troubleshooting resources.
- [Security](https://yashab-cyber.github.io/opendroid/security.html): Security practices and disclosures.
- [Privacy](https://yashab-cyber.github.io/opendroid/privacy.html): Privacy information.
- [Terms](https://yashab-cyber.github.io/opendroid/terms.html): Terms of service.

## Source
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/yashab-cyber/opendroid): Source code, issues, releases, and project history.
